audit_objective: Consolidated forensic baseline quantifying extraction recall, rejection rates, lost educational knowledge, and quality gate false acceptance rate in V12 pipeline

architectural_failure_points.impact: Discarded 99.95% of factual sentences because valid knowledge sentences started with prepositional phrases, dates, numbers, or dependent clauses.
Categorized all markdown tables, tabular data, and ASCII schemas as TABLE_OR_META and skipped them completely.
Distractor pool cross-polled unrelated predicates, pairing oceanic crust density with demographic migration or atmospheric visibility.
Synthesized corrupt stems from truncated clauses such as 'The Nile basin is huge and'.
100% false acceptance rate; zero questions rejected despite fatal semantic, grammatical, and cognitive defects.
